decision.comment: Comparison stage is internally consistent and arithmetically correct. Verified: agentic_accuracy (0.921448) − baseline_accuracy (0.840251) = 0.081197, matching the reported accuracy_delta. Both models share the same seed (47) and split fingerprint (9afc9ed3…c7505), ensuring a fair like-for-like evaluation on identical data. The baseline is a fixed tiny_cnn control (hidden=16, depth=2, 15 epochs) while the agentic run is ResNet18 (hidden=48 base width; depth field inactive per fixed-topology policy). Transformer-specific fields in the baseline config (num_heads, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, mlp_ratio, tokenizer_layers) are correctly inactive for the CNN family and do not alter the architecture. The 8.12 pp improvement is meaningful and the baseline is met/exceeded. No deterministic findings are present. The OOD AUROC warning (0.3938 < 0.5, anti-correlated confidence at σ≥0.25) is already tracked at warning severity in the abstention and reporting stages; it does not invalidate the in-distribution accuracy comparison and does not constitute a deterministic finding requiring stop. Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall of 56.5% and the ~7.5 pp val-test gap are noted observations carried forward from evaluation; they do not affect the comparison's validity. Proceed to next stage.
issues: warning: OOD AUROC (0.3938) below random chance is a known limitation of the max_softmax abstention mechanism at σ≥0.25; already tracked in abstention/reporting stages, does not block comparison
info: Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall 56.5% (F1=0.70) is the weakest class; 110/421 misclassified primarily to smooth muscle (63) and debris (47); carried from evaluation stage
info: Val-test accuracy gap ~7.5 pp (99.60% val vs 92.14% test) noted as generalization observation; not a pipeline defect

request.system: You are an independent software and ML consistency reviewer. Inspect only the supplied evidence. You may raise severity but must never dismiss deterministic findings. No clinical claims. The supplied current UTC timestamp is authoritative. This pipeline uses the standard 28x28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; do not substitute the source-dataset or MedMNIST+ resolution. Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
